newsitem.title: USA: TABLE - Primus Telecom sells $225 mln in debt.
newsitem.headline: TABLE - Primus Telecom sells $225 mln in debt.

text.p: The following 144a private placement of debt from Primus Telecommunications Group Inc was priced on Wednesday via Lehman Brothers Inc, according to market sources.
The deal was increased to $225 million from an initial $125 million, due to strong demand.
Primus, headquartered in Vienna, Va, provides long-distance telephone services in markets in Asia, the U.S. and Europe.
